run_materialize_multihot_dataset: run the script to materialize synthetic multi-hot dataset from Criteo binary npy files into npz format
run_multihot_with_pareto_distribution: run the script with pareto distribution type to generate multi-hot sparse dataset for all days
run_multihot_with_copy_labels: run the script with copy labels and dense flag to include labels and dense data in output
run_distributed_multihot_materialization: run the script in distributed mode across multiple GPUs using NCCL backend for parallel dataset generation
review_parse_args_multihot: review the parse_args function to understand CLI arguments for multi-hot dataset materialization including embedding sizes and distribution type
